description: A water bottle that folds down flat when empty so it fits in a pocket or small bag. Holds 600 ml (20 oz) when open, about 4 cm tall when folded. Leak-proof screw cap with a carabiner clip.
features: Made of food-grade silicone with a polypropylene cap
Folds from 22 cm to 4 cm tall
For cold or room-temperature drinks only, not for hot drinks
dimensions: Open: 22 x 7.5 cm; folded: 4 x 7.5 cm; weight 110 g
